question: Before 2026, how many June 21sts in Milan averaged 30 °C?
answer: Before 2026, no June 21st in Milan had an average temperature of 30 °C. Across the 54 June 21sts from 1973 to 2025, none reached that mark, and 2026 was the first. The card links the rise in average temperatures to the climate crisis.
move: In 54 years of June 21sts, Milan hit a 30 °C average only once: in 2026.
